outcome: Maternal complications (miscarriage, perinatal mortality, pre-eclampsia, postpartum hemorrhage, postpartum hematoma, maternal deaths, thrombotic events)
Delivery outcomes (induced delivery, Cesarean section rate, gestational age at delivery)
Neonatal outcomes (birth weight, admission to neonatal care unit, neonatal deaths)
cohort: 58 pregnant women with a diagnosis of MPN identified through the United Kingdom Obstetric Surveillance System between January 2010 and December 2012
finding: Women with MPN in this study experienced better pregnancy outcomes than previously reported in the literature, with low rates of maternal and neonatal complications.
birth_weight: 22% (12/54) of neonates were below the 10th centile for growth
